map.创业或内部项目立项时起名：给定核心词（如「笔记/效率」），组合生成易记、易读的应: Naming at startup or internal project kick-off: given core words (such as "notes / efficiency"), generate memorable, easy-to-read app names as a candidate list before publishing to the App Store or an Android store.
map.为海外版本准备英文名：在中文候选基础上生成可读的英文/拼音组合，便于后续查域名与: Preparing English names for an overseas version: generate readable English/pinyin combinations from Chinese candidates to make later domain and trademark checks easier.
map.做 A/B 命名测试：一次产出多个风格（极简/叠词/功能型），供团队投票或用户调: Running A/B naming tests: produce several styles at once (minimal / reduplicative / functional) for team voting or user research.
map.关键词填「笔记、效率」，风格选「功能型」，生成「速记星、NoteFlow、闪记、: Enter the keywords "notes, efficiency" and choose the "functional" style to generate candidates such as "QuickNote, NoteFlow, SnapNote, EfficiencyBox"; among them NoteFlow reads well in English and the domain note-flow.com is likely unregistered, making it a good name for an overseas version.
map.生成的应用名能直接用吗？: Can the generated app names be used directly?
map.仅作灵感与候选，正式上线前务必查商标（中国商标网/USPTO）、应用商店重名与域: They are only inspiration and candidates; before launch, always check trademarks (CNIPA / USPTO), store name clashes and domain availability to avoid infringement or being unable to publish.
map.应用名长度有讲究吗？: Does the app name length matter?
map.商店搜索与图标下方展示空间有限，2~4 个汉字或不超过 12 个字母最易记；过长: Store search and the space under the icon are limited, so 2-4 Chinese characters or no more than 12 letters are easiest to remember; anything longer gets truncated and spreads less by word of mouth.
